drivingQuestion: What do we say to the witnesses to intimidate them?

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ הֵיכִי אָמְרִינַן לְהוּ? אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה: הָכִי אָמְרִינַן לְהוּ, ״נְשִׂיאִים וְרוּחַ וְגֶשֶׁם אָיִן אִישׁ מִתְהַלֵּל בְּמַתַּת שָׁקֶר״.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The mishna teaches that the judges intimidate the witnesses. The Gemara asks: «What do we say to them? Rav Yehuda says» that «this» is what «we say to them:» It is stated: «“As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts himself of a false gift”» (Proverbs 25:14). In other words, there will be no rain and no blessing from your deeds if you lie.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא, יָכְלִי לְמֵימַר: שַׁב שְׁנֵי הֲוָה כַּפְנָא, וְאַבָּבָא אוּמָּנָא לָא חֲלֵיף.
segments.en: «Rava said to him:» If so, false witnesses «can say» to themselves that they do not have to worry about this punishment, according to the folk saying: «Seven years there was a famine, but over the craftsman’s door it did not pass.» If the witnesses are not farmers, they do not need to worry over lack of rain. Consequently, they will disregard this concern.

segments.he: אֶלָּא אָמַר רָבָא, אָמְרִינַן לְהוּ: ״מֵפִיץ וְחֶרֶב וְחֵץ שָׁנוּן אִישׁ עֹנֶה בְרֵעֵהוּ עֵד שָׁקֶר״.
segments.en: «Rather, Rava said» that «we say» this verse «to them: “As a hammer, and a sword, and a sharp arrow, so is a man who bears false witness against his neighbor”» (Proverbs 25:18), meaning that a false witness will die prematurely.

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב אָשֵׁי, יָכְלִי לְמֵימַר: שַׁב שְׁנֵי הֲוָה מוֹתָנָא, וְאִינִישׁ בְּלָא שְׁנֵיהּ לָא שְׁכֵיב.
segments.en: «Rav Ashi said to him:» Here too, false witnesses «can say» to themselves a folk saying: «Seven years there was a pestilence, but a man» who has «not» reached «his years did not die;» everyone dies at his predestined time. Therefore, they will disregard this concern as well.

segments.he: אֶלָּא אָמַר רַב אָשֵׁי: אָמַר לִי נָתָן בַּר מָר זוּטְרָא, אָמְרִינַן לְהוּ: סָהֲדֵי שַׁקָּרֵי אַאוֹגְרַיְיהוּ זִילִי, דִּכְתִיב: ״וְהוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַיִם אֲנָשִׁים בְּנֵי בְלִיַּעַל נֶגְדּוֹ וִיעִדֻהוּ לֵאמֹר בֵּרַכְתָּ אֱלֹהִים וָמֶלֶךְ״.
segments.en: The Gemara presents another suggestion: «Rather, Rav Ashi said: Natan bar Mar Zutra said to me» that «we say to them» that «false witnesses are belittled» even «by those who hire them,» and all the more so by others; «as it is written» that Jezebel said when she ordered witnesses to be hired to testify against Naboth: «“And set two men, base fellows, before him, and let them bear witness against him, saying: You cursed God and the king”» (I Kings 21:10). Even Jezebel, who gave the orders to hire them, called them “base fellows.”
